geographic_rule: Reference pressure is not current-axis depth. Geographic/averaging windows are not paired edges. Model boundaries and zero velocity-anomaly contours do not establish total-flow boundaries; do not add the WOA01 mean to the differently referenced altimetric anomaly field without reviewed compatibility.
remaining_gates: Acquire compatible numerical mean/monthly velocity fields and resolve their reference state, averaging periods and uncertainty.
Recover longitudinal connected velocity-core support and source-defined gates before tracing a route; do not bridge separated positive components.
Use paired total-flow boundaries for local width extraction; anomaly zero crossings remain inadmissible as current-width edges.
Keep 2004 relative-geostrophic support separate from the 2026 Argo absolute-geostrophic envelopes and ENSO composites.
